title: A story quest's status (none, offered, taken, handed in) and its objective counter
oneLine: Per-quest status absent/available/active/turnedIn plus counted objectives; server-owned, predicted by the phone before the answer.
topConcern: Unmet-objective and not-active hand-ins are refused silently on v2, leaving the phone's predicted gold and turnedIn; mayor_3 still paid on the game's word.

title: A quest's rewards on their way: granted, overflowed, mailed, or handed to the phone
oneLine: Grant pass per accept/hand-in: stash, scratch overflow, inbox credit with opIds, armour announced to the phone.
topConcern: Status set, then the unfit-weapon inbox credit awaited, then saved: a restart there can duplicate a weapon; quest armour exists server-side only as a row.

title: The achievements record: loaded, locked or forgotten; each achievement earned once (or counted)
oneLine: Per-player achv record cache (got/n/dg/t, locked) with grants at every settling site, a join sweep and a title.
topConcern: Mail drain writes `got` before an awaited gear row and the rpg save: a restart loses the arena's 500 AP; dev clear re-pays AP.

title: The arena's once-a-character points mark (aponce) and the Gladiator achievement
oneLine: aponce mark loaded before mail, set by either road, saved in the rpg blob's own write.

title: The monster codex record: counted in memory, written on a fact, a timer or the close
oneLine: Per-player kill counts per kind with dirty/savedAt flush on the next kill past 60 s and on close.
topConcern: No tick flush: dirty counts wait for the next kill or the close, so a pause then a deploy loses them.

title: The pets record: loaded, locked, moved in once, written at once or on a timer
oneLine: Per-player pets record cache with the one-time old-pet move, dirty journal, xpFrac, rate window, admin look lever.
topConcern: Old pets' move: record put unawaited while the rpg blob empties lifeSkills.pets later; a failed record put loses them.

title: A pet's life: caught, held a day, out with you or put away, traded, released
oneLine: Per pet: trade hold, legacy flag, active or idle, level capped at Trapping, taken and given by trade, store, mail.

title: The free daily spin's run: ready, spun (a pot at rest), doubled, taken, lost, kept at midnight
oneLine: Daily free spin, bonus spins, an open pot doubled or taken, paid at the day's end, opId per act.
topConcern: Pay closes the pot in memory, saved two awaits later; a restart there leaves it open, and after the 48 h prune it pays again.

title: The daily-rewards record cache and the day's turnover (load, dirty, save, forget; midnight online)
oneLine: Per-player daily_rewards cache, dirty map, turnover lock, pending news and kept-pot maps, tick flush and midnight turnover.
topConcern: Turnover pays and must be saved by every caller; only __drTurning guards _drNewDayOnline, not the acts' own turnovers.

title: The three daily quests: rolled, counted, done and paid, rerolled once (put away)
oneLine: Daily board of three quests, counted signals, paid in one run with the record, one reroll; off unless dailyquests.
topConcern: Dormant; a stale-day signal is dropped and a refused reroll answers nothing if it is turned back on.

title: The season track and its streak freezes (dropped: only the drop's mail-out runs)
oneLine: Season stars, tiers claimed or mailed, overflow spins; dropped, so each turnover mails reached unclaimed tiers once.
topConcern: Freeze grants have no stamp and tier mail-outs rely on 48 h stamps; a restart before the record save can grant them again.

title: The daily chest in the bag: owned, opened once, prize rolled (legacy drain)
oneLine: Opens daily chests already in bags (none minted since v2.3.3140); bag count re-checked after awaits, opId stamped.
topConcern: opId stamp awaited before the save: a restart drops the same-opId retry silently; no loss, no double.

title: A trained combat skill's XP and level, and the points each level mints (prog3)
oneLine: Per-skill XP and level 1-100, lane and shared point minting, character level by best skill or sum.
topConcern: Shared points mint by the onelevel flag at each level-up, the re-deal by one-level always, the reset by the flag then; flips mix rules.

title: The prog3 block's shape and its one-time stamps (atk split, elem fold, luck fold, ppl, spl, olr, ms)
oneLine: Six one-way idempotent folds run by migrations and again by _sanitizeProg3 at each join, held by stamps.
topConcern: Any stamp the sanitizer forgets to carry turns a one-time grant or re-deal into one per join.

title: Spending points and the free reset (pool, lane pools, shared pool; the reset's minute)
oneLine: One point a prog3_allocate from lane, shared or spare pools; a free reset refused mid-fight, dead, or within a minute.
topConcern: The reset refuses fights and the dead, the spend checks neither; the reset's minute is memory-only and a reconnect skips it.

title: pets.js: the retired capture, and the pet fetch's pickup range
oneLine: pet_capture always answers retired; a viaPet pickup range of 600 or 240 px by pile and flag.

title: The legacy T2 build-point economy (t2Flat accumulator, spend-level pricing)
oneLine: Old grid build accumulator, replayed at join and echoed, read as 0 for every prog3 player.
topConcern: Dead weight kept for rollback: replayed at every join and echoed on every player_state.

title: data.js tables that are the explicit half of machines elsewhere
oneLine: QUEST_*, GUILD_QUESTS, DISHES, PVP_HEAL, MANA_SURGE, zone ids: constants that drive other machines.
topConcern: GUILD_QUESTS is keyed by array index into stored claim counts; a reorder re-maps every claim.
